title: Number lines while reading a file
description: You pair each incoming file line with an updated counter.

steps.description: You open groceries.txt for reading and initialize count. The counter starts before the loop.
You receive one line per pass and concatenate it with the counter text. str converts count before the string addition.

steps.question: Does the print use count before or after its increment?
steps.answer: It uses count before the increment. The next pass receives the updated value.

steps.description: You increment the counter and close the file after the loop. The recording shows numbered grocery lines with blank lines between them.
